svg.metadata: Second preset character: shop clothes, one group per item (top_<mode or card>_<name>, set_<name>_top / _hat, plus <item>_rub_sleeve and <item>_invite_sleeve for the eye-rub and invite arms). Drawn over her figure in the same 120 x 140 frame. Tops replace her jacket_* part; set hats sit under cat_ears, except set_rain_hat, which hides cat_ears and draws its own. Sleeve fill per item (for arms recoloured at runtime): top_work_sailor white, top_work_argyle white, top_chill_strawberry petal, top_chill_cathoodie sky, top_side_gingham white, top_side_denim sky, set_picnic white, set_rain yellow, top_box_lilac lilac, top_tennis_sakura sakura, top_fitness_track sky, top_study_sweater yellow, top_art_smock white, base_outing_trench navy, base_craft_pinafore white with navy stripes, base_sport_tank none (bare arm, skin). Back views for the turn-away pose: <item>_back for every top (set_picnic_back, set_rain_back for the sets), body outline in the base colour only; hats have no back view. Sunday items: weekly_hair_<mint|cherry|star>_pony (tennis ponytail) and _side (side clip point), weekly_blanket_bear, weekly_room_cloud, weekly_room_succulent, weekly_room_nightlight with weekly_room_nightlight_glow (drawn at full strength; the figure sets its opacity), weekly_hat_beanie with weekly_hat_beanie_pom. Boxing look: box_shoulder_towel, a white towel with a pink stripe on her right shoulder, drawn over jacket_box; it has no back view. data-before names the figure part each Sunday item is drawn in front of.
